Title: A multicentre, randomized clinical trial comparing the Veriset™ haemostatic patch with fibrin sealant for the management of bleeding during hepatic surgery
Author: Öllinger et al.
Comment: Randomized intention-to-treat denominators (32 Veriset; 18 TachoSil) were used as required by the synthesis plan. The safety population was 32 versus 17 because one participant randomized to TachoSil received an argon-beam non-study procedure. The paper reports one death in each randomized arm but does not report a risk ratio or confidence interval; these fields are therefore left null. Under the synthesis definitions, Veriset is the non-fibrin control and TachoSil is the fibrin-based intervention, despite TachoSil being called the control in the paper.
Design Type: Prospective multicentre two-arm randomized patient-blinded non-inferiority trial
Study Environment: Six European hospitals; non-emergent open hepatic surgery
Topic of Content: Topical haemostatic patches used for diffuse bleeding during hepatic surgery
Participant type: Adults undergoing non-emergent open hepatic surgery
Outcome measurement: Death from any cause occurring during the trial; safety events were collected during the 30-day follow-up period
effect_direction: more deaths with the fibrin-based agent
